qualification: local A05.3 direct-chain reliability isolation; not A05.3 closure, performance acceptance, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

candidate.scope: Enable only direct and conditional generated branch patches in the production PC machine. Keep the IBTC and shadow-return stack absent from generated execution while preserving ordinary generated execution, Tier one, native trace replay, the physical block cache, and precise recovery.
candidate.behavioralIntent: Determine whether direct branch patches are reliable independently of indirect raw host-address prediction.
candidate.productionFinding: The first exact-binary run passed all seven workloads. The second qualifying run of the identical binary emitted corrupted NUL-containing kernel strings, passed only the first six workload records, faulted busybox at an inaccessible dynamic-loader address during the final workload, soft-locked in unmap_page_range, and exhausted one billion instructions without an authenticated terminal receipt. Direct chaining alone is therefore sufficient to reproduce the intermittent guest-corruption family under this fixture.

verification.focused: The direct-only and all-off predictor regressions plus the DoryPCDirectKernelMachine suite passed 36 tests in two suites.
verification.deterministicAggregate: 1,557 tests in 179 suites passed with test parallelism disabled; the environment-driven pinned boot test skipped because its variables were absent, then the same pinned inputs were executed explicitly.

runs.observedFailure: NUL-corrupted RCU, PCI ECAM, and TSC strings; busybox PID 405 page fault at 0x7f6d49d81096 in the dynamic-loader mapping; CPU soft lockup in unmap_page_range and related page-table/scheduler paths.

excludedAttempt.reason: The process and observation handle did not survive the turn boundary. No result, counters, or guest progress are inferred, and this attempt is not counted.

retainedBaseline.reason: The direct-only candidate failed correctness and is reverted, so neither its passing-run nor failure-run counter is accepted as performance evidence.

disposition.reason: One passing run cannot override an identical-binary guest-corruption failure. The production PC default returns to the empty predictor set. The next direct-chain investigation must identify and exclude or repair the corrupting edge before any raw direct target is re-enabled.

limitations: The failure receipt proves corruption while only direct raw targets were enabled, but does not identify the first corrupting branch edge.
The guest reached six workload records before the terminal failure, so boot success or partial userspace progress is not a sufficient reliability proxy.
The isolated failure does not assess IBTC or shadow-return reliability because both remained disabled.
The raw diagnostic receipts remain in the local fixture directory; this checked-in record binds their hashes and selected counters.
